title: NoéMI issue-coding-loop client registry
description: NOEMI_CLIENT_REGISTRY: client orgs entitled to the operator's pool tenant (Decision [2026-10-22-0005]). Injected from the vault at runtime; never committed. A client is entitled only when the conductor App is installed on the repo (or, on another forge, that provider's grant exists) AND its account has an active row here for that provider.

provider.description: Forge this row grants: github (default) or azure-devops. Aliases gh, ado and azdo are accepted. A row never matches an account on another forge.

account_id.description: Stable forge account ID. GitHub: the integer account ID of the org or user the App is installed on (required to be an integer when provider is github). Azure DevOps: the organization GUID. Stable across renames; the login is not used for matching.

login.description: Human label only. Not used for matching.

repos.description: Optional allowlist inside the grant: a bare GitHub owner/name, or a full provider key such as azure-devops:org/project/repo. Missing or empty means every repo the grant covers.
